report.question: How much NEW information does each additional round actually add, and at what point is the council merely restating itself? Define per-round information gain (new distinct claims, new evidence nodes, changed votes, entropy of the position distribution) and use it to detect a non-converging debate and a council that loops forever without information gain. The deliverable is the measured gain curve for at least six protocols, not a hardcoded round cap.
